summary.text: Chao Wu is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 9A who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An electrical engineer and data scientist by training, he previously served on the Howard County Board of Education, including as board chair.

paragraphs.text: Wu was born in Yingshan, Hubei, China, and earned a bachelor's degree in engineering from the University of Science and Technology of China in 2001, a master's degree in electrical and computer engineering from the National University of Singapore in 2003, and a Ph.D. in electrical and computer engineering from the University of Maryland, College Park, in 2009.

He worked as a senior electrical engineer at Maryland Aerospace Inc. and as an aviation software engineer at Garmin International, founded ATOP Intelligence, was a senior research and development engineer at Hillcrest Labs, and was a senior data scientist at Booz Allen Hamilton from 2018 to 2021.
Wu served on the Howard County Board of Education from 2018 to 2022 and was its chair in 2020 and 2021.
He was elected to the House in November 2022 and took office on January 11, 2023.

He serves on the Government, Labor, and Elections Committee and its Corrections and Government Operations and Ethics subcommittees, served on the Ways and Means Committee from 2023 to 2025, and chaired the Howard County House Delegation in 2024 and 2025.
He advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary for District 9A.
